info.title: PlateBack API
info.description: Reserve surplus food from local businesses and collect it with a pickup code. All endpoints are under /api/v1. Errors are RFC 9457 ProblemDetails with a machine-readable `code`. Sign in with POST /auth/login and send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

post.description: Creates the account, signs it in and sets the refresh-token cookie. Rate limited per IP address.
Returns a 15-minute access token and sets a 7-day refresh-token cookie. Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes (429 RATE_LIMITED).

Uses the refresh-token cookie, rotates it and returns a new access token. Reusing a token rotated more than 30 seconds ago ends every session of that account; inside that window only a new access token is returned.
Revokes the current refresh token and clears the cookie.

get.description: Profile, reliability score and business memberships.

post.description: Starts as Pending until an admin verifies it. The caller becomes its Owner.

get.description: Public when verified. Pending, rejected or suspended businesses are visible only to their members and admins; anyone else gets 404.

post.summary: Add a staff member by email
post.description: Owners only. The person must already have a PlateBack account. Returns the updated team.

delete.description: Owners only. The last owner cannot be removed (409 INVALID_STATE).

get.description: Members only. Active listings, portions reserved, collected today, meals rescued this month and a 14-day series. Days follow the business's time zone.
Members only. Optional status filter. Open listings first (soonest pickup), then past ones.

post.description: Members of a verified business only (403 ORG_NOT_VERIFIED otherwise). The pickup window must be 15 minutes to 12 hours and end in the future.

get.description: Members only. Reservations for pickups ending today or later; waiting ones first.
Live listings from verified businesses. With lat and lng: within radiusKm (default 5, maximum 25), sorted by distance by default. Sold-out listings come last.
Includes live stock, the allergen note and how many units one person may reserve.

put.description: Members only, live listings only. Quantity cannot drop below the units already reserved. 409 CONFLICT if the listing changed while you edited it.

post.description: Members only. Its reservations are cancelled without penalty and the customers are notified.
Returns the pickup code. 409 SOLD_OUT when the stock went to someone else first, LIMIT_REACHED when the customer already holds their maximum, WINDOW_CLOSED when the listing has ended.

get.description: Meals rescued, partner businesses and live listings. Cached for 5 minutes.

post.description: multipart/form-data with one field named file: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB. The type is checked from the file's content. Use the returned url as the listing's imageUrl.

get.description: status=active (default, soonest pickup first) or status=history (most recent first).
For the customer or a member of the listing's business; 404 for anyone else.

post.description: Free before the pickup window opens; after that it is a late cancellation (-5 reliability). Stock goes back while the listing is open.

post.summary: Hand over food with a pickup code
post.description: Staff enter the customer's code (case and spaces do not matter). Codes from other businesses fail like unknown codes. Rate limited per user.

get.description: Newest first, with unreadCount for the bell.
Businesses by status (Pending, Verified, Rejected, Suspended), oldest first, with the owner's name and email.

post.description: Also lifts a suspension. The owners are notified.
A reason is required and is shown to the owner.
A reason is required. Its live listings and their reservations are cancelled.

get.description: By part of the name or by exact email.

post.description: A reason is required. Ends the account's sessions; it can no longer log in or reserve.
A reason is required. Its reservations are cancelled and the business is notified.

get.description: Every state change, newest first. Filter by entityType, entityId or actorId.
